name: OMTech Polar 2
tagline: Desktop CO₂ with a 28 × 14 in bed: 70W glass tube or 50W RF tube
tldr: The Polar 2, launched in July 2026, succeeds the original Polar with a 710 × 360 mm bed, a 16 MP full-bed camera, one-touch auto-focus, air assist, exhaust fan and a rotary in the box. Two sources: a 70W water-cooled glass tube ($3,699.99) for cutting, or a 50W air-cooled RF tube ($4,999.99) for fast, fine engraving. Open a tier for exact specs.
mainObjective: Desktop CO₂ for acrylic and wood on a bigger bed, as a complete package

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm acrylic

cut: Acrylic up to ~8–10 mm depending on tube (estimate)
cannot: Sheets longer than the bed (no pass-through)

pros: Much larger bed than the original Polar while staying a desktop machine
Camera, auto-focus, air assist, exhaust fan, rotary and LightBurn key included
Choice of tube: glass for cutting value, RF for engraving speed and longevity
cons: About 1.2 m wide: needs a sturdy table and an outside vent
New model: figures are OMTech's until independent reviews arrive
beginnerNotes: This overview covers the whole Polar 2 line. Pick the 70W glass version if you mostly cut acrylic and wood, the 50W RF version if you mostly engrave and want minimal maintenance.
proTips: Plan the exhaust route before delivery. On the glass version, keep an eye on the internal coolant; on the RF version, keep air intakes clean.
primaryUse: Desktop CO₂ laser for acrylic, wood and small business production.

faq.question: 70W glass or 50W RF?
faq.answer: Glass for cutting thicker stock at a lower price; RF for faster, finer engraving, about three times the rated tube life and air cooling.

faq.question: Does the Polar 2 replace the original Polar?
faq.answer: Yes. The original Polar 50W is no longer sold new by OMTech; the Polar 2 is its successor with a larger bed.
